name: Windsurf

ui_steps: Settings > Tools > Windsurf Settings > Add Server, or Cascade MCP menu

plan_limits: Teams: admins toggle MCP and may allowlist servers (one allowlisted server blocks all others). Enterprise: users must turn MCP on manually.
